pandas.DataFrame.resample

pandas 3.1.1 · DataFrame · method

Create time bins from a datetime-like axis, then reduce, fill or upsample within those bins.

  • Call syntax
  • Run the example

Call syntax

DataFrame.resample(…) Full signature
DataFrame.resample(
    rule,
    closed=None,
    label=None,
    convention='start',
    on=None,
    level=None,
    origin='start_day',
    offset=None,
    group_keys=False,
)
